surface: All676 frozen scalp-source triangles, including previous atlas exclusions; new coverage is authored here, old partition not mutated
axis: source head bone head_local x/y; front azimuth atan2(abs(x-axisX),-(y-axisY)); [0,pi]
interpolation: piecewise smoothstep s=t*t*(3-2*t), z=headZ+H*lerp(knot heights,s); independent artist choices, not concept metrics
field: F(sourceID)=sourceZ-boundaryZ(theta); inside F>=0; linear interpolation of fixed native vertex fields within each source triangle, not analytic re-evaluation at intersections
zero_case: abs(F)<=epsilon maps exact original shared native ID; an edge with two zero vertices remains one original edge; adjacent zero-area polygon/duplicate point refuses; no nearzero perturbation
shared_edge: canonical ascending nativeID pair, t=F(lo)/(F(lo)-F(hi)); weights (1-t,t), one interpolated coordinate per edge, no duplicate seam points
normal: area-weighted average of all incident676 source triangle normals normalized per nativeID; new intersections interpolate these normals and renormalize
source_triangle_region: centroid z >= headZ+.86H => crown; else azimuth<=110degrees => temple; else nape
height: area-weighted incident source triangle nominal heights per nativeID; new edgepoint uses same canonical linear interpolation
taper: BFS distance from new clipped perimeter in new triangulated domain; .15+.85*smoothstep(min(distance/3,1))
source_coordinates: Float32 source-native world coordinates; intersection coordinates are Float32 weighted values; source weights/coordinates retained with 1e-6m native association tolerance
triangulation: preserve source winding; convex triangle clip polygon, fan triangulation; positive source-normal projected area>1e-14 required; sum clipped areas<=source area plus1e-12
boundary: one connected retained domain; all edges one boundary/two opposite interiors; boundary graph all degree2 and exactlyone loop; every boundary point has abs(linear F)<=1e-10 or refuse inherited source-patch border
mass: outer clipped points + source-coincident base + boundary walls; shared IDs only; closed two-opposite-incidence polygons
prospective_gate: unchanged artist ear boxes/forehead predicates on all outer source-authored triangles; any overlap refuses before native with no diagnostic exception
stop: first unowned/degenerate/correspondence/loop/winding/area/envelope failure; one author attempt, no fixed-shape edits/variants; native only after independent preflight
limits: C0 mesh-edge continuity only, not visually smooth curve proof or final hairline; source normal/lift coverage differs from old mass and is not old geometry preservation
